primary_anchor_zh: 柔和长脸、齐肩金棕色直发和深青色长裙
story_reason_zh: 她去后台取松香，随后回到舞台座椅

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 年轻女大提琴手在旧剧院的单人舞台中央，以平稳长弓缓慢拉奏大提琴。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 以平稳长弓缓慢拉奏大提琴
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 柔和长脸、齐肩金棕色直发和深青色长裙占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由舞台侧幕缓慢走出画面；随后呈现空木椅、大提琴支架和暗红幕布。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由舞台侧幕缓慢走出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空木椅、大提琴支架和暗红幕布

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由舞台侧幕缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由舞台侧幕缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚展示柔和长脸、齐肩金棕色直发和深青色长裙，并保持相近景别与主体占比。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a young woman with a soft long face, straight shoulder-length golden-brown hair, and a deep teal dress on a single chair at the center of an old theater stage. She draws the bow across a cello in slow, even strokes. A soft ivory spotlight separates her from the dim hall.

A fixed medium shot shows a young woman with a soft long face, straight shoulder-length golden-brown hair, and a deep teal dress walking slowly behind the side curtain until she leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty wooden chair, the cello stand, and the dark red theater curtain. The lower edge of the curtain moves slightly.

A fixed medium shot shows a young woman with a soft long face, straight shoulder-length golden-brown hair, and a deep teal dress walking slowly back from behind the side curtain and settling on a single chair at the center of an old theater stage.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 主体经由舞台侧幕缓慢走出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空木椅、大提琴支架和暗红幕布
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 主体经由舞台侧幕缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
